message.content: Halo! Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS, saya perlu masuk ke sistem Anda terlebih dahulu. Bisakah Anda memberikan nama pengguna dan kata sandi (atau memberi tahu saya apakah Anda ingin saya menggunakan kredensial yang sudah tersimpan)? Jika Anda tidak ingin berbagi informasi login di sini, beri tahu saya produk atau kategori apa yang Anda maksud, dan saya akan mencoba membantu dengan cara lain.

The tool is user_authentication_login. But we don't have username/password. The user didn't provide credentials. We might ask for credentials or proceed? The user is asking about product availability. We might need to authenticate to get data. But we don't have credentials. We could respond asking for login or provide general info. The user didn't mention product. We can ask clarifying question: which product? Or we can say we need to log in. Probably ask for login.
